BH-5967: how long a project's stranded-ticket count (the stranded watch's state/stranded-watch/

/.count) or its parked-PR count (conductor rows BLOCKED_HUMAN or RED_TWICE) may stand above 0 before ONE alert per metric per day names the project. A count of 0 ends the episode, and the epilogue resolves the page (noprogress is in RETRACT_NS). 0 pages on the first tick above 0.
BH-5967: a stranded-ticket count older than this is not read (no number is not 0). 5400 is three runs of the 30-minute stranded watch.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's cost budget block (cb_knob): the multiple of a project's $/PR budget at which the autohalt holds its new builds (flags/spend-hold-

, BH-5526). The autohalt is ON by default since K1 (2026-09-24); COST_AUTOHALT and flags/cost-autohalt-off are its kill switches. docs/COST.md.

K1 (2026-09-24): 1 = the cost breakers HOLD a project's new builds at the build launch gate (flags/spend-hold-

, the flag row; work already in progress continues, BH-5526) when it crosses COST_AUTOHALT_MULTIPLE x its $/PR budget or the zero-merge rule; 0 = page only. Was an opt-in file (flags/cost-autohalt-optin) no box had. The file flags/cost-autohalt-off is the second kill switch and wins. docs/COST.md.

K1: after the breaker holds a project it does not hold the same project again for this many seconds (state/costhalt/

), so an operator who lifted the hold is not overruled by the same 24h/7d window. docs/COST.md.

K1 zero-merge breaker, 24h window: at least this much DELIVERY spend over 24h with fewer than COST_ZM_MIN_MERGES merged in 24h. HOLDS new builds only when the project's 7d merges (max of merged_prs_7d and merged_prs_24h) are also under the minimum; a project that merged this week and not today is paged, never held (a fleet-wide merge stop must not hold every board). Only spend after the last halt stamp is judged. Per project: lane.pipeline-health.<project>.cost_zm_24h_usd. docs/COST.md.

K1 zero-merge breaker, 7d window (project-9: $643/7d, 0 merged): at least this much delivery spend over 7d with fewer than COST_ZM_MIN_MERGES merged (by MERGE date) in 7d holds the project's new builds. Judged only once the 7d window lies wholly after the last halt. Per project: lane.pipeline-health.<project>.cost_zm_7d_usd. docs/COST.md.
K1 zero-merge breaker: fewer merged PRs than this in the window counts as 'zero merges'. Per project: lane.pipeline-health.<project>.cost_zm_min_merges. docs/COST.md.

K1: the dollars the fleet ceiling charges an rc-0 cost row that reported NO usage and carries no cost_usd. Rows WITH tokens and no cost are priced at their model's rate, or the price table's top rate for an unknown model; subscription (billing_mode) rows add nothing. Brake arithmetic only; no report reads it. docs/COST.md.
K1: more than this many unpriced cost rows from ONE runner in the last hour pages critical (costunpriced:<runner>, once a day). docs/COST.md.

BH-3316: bin/pipeline-health.sh's 'stranded queue row' block pages strandedqueue:

: for a queued build_queue row this many minutes old whose target nothing will claim (target=local on a fly1/pool-routed project, or fly while routing is halted). A value that is not a whole number falls back to 60.

BH-3480: bin/pipeline-health.sh's 'stale dequeue' block pages staledequeue:

: for an open PR carrying merge-queue whose newest Mergify payload has said dequeued for this many minutes with no head committed since. A value that is not a positive whole number falls back to 30.

BH-3778: bin/pipeline-health.sh's 'lead merge unqueued' block pages leadunqueued:<owner/repo>#<n>:<head12> once per head for an open, non-draft PR on a LEAD_REVIEW_AUTO_REPOS repo, based on the default branch, whose head has carried lead-verdict success for at least this many minutes while Mergify is not holding it (no queued / checking label). A junk value reads as 30.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh as ${SWEEPSTALL_SECS:-600}: how long an APPROVE'd, OPEN, CLEAN PR may sit outside the merge queue (and not STACKED_WAIT) before the sweepstall page, which names the conductor's row and last log line. Lane D (2026-09-24) cut it from 1800: with the enqueue lock-free a CLEAN approved PR is queued within a tick, so ten minutes unqueued is a bug with a name, not a wait. Registered by BH-1165; no reviewed min/max yet.

The sweepstall detector (bin/pipeline-health.sh, 'sweep should have landed') skips an APPROVE + OPEN + CLEAN PR whose merge-conductor row is READY when the conductor recorded a hold reason for that head (state/merge-conductor/ready-why/<key>, written by mc_ready_why every tick the READY arm holds it) within this many conductor ticks (a tick = max(MC_TICK_SECS, 300)s). Older than that, the conductor stopped saying why and the PR pages, quoting that reason. A MERGE_HELD or PR-dependency-gate log line for the head exempts it regardless.
Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh as ${TMP_FULL_PCT:-80}. Registered by BH-1165 so it is visible and settable; no reviewed min/max yet, so nothing is clamped.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh as ${RESTORE_DRILL_STALE_DAYS:-8}: days without a passing restore drill (counted from the first run when none has passed) before restoredrillstale pages. A value that is not a positive whole number is logged and 8 is used. BH-400.3.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh as ${HARNESS_CHECKOUT:-/root/harness-checkout} for section 8 (fleet checkout freshness, BH-2529). The checkout path a test seam overrides; NOT settable from the control plane — only env/global.env on the box moves it.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's pause expiry warning block: a live pauses row (state/pauses.json, refreshed by pause_refresh) whose expires_at falls within this many seconds pages once per (scope, what, expires_at), so a board pause never lapses unannounced. 0 = off; a value that is not a whole number falls back to 7200.

BH-3437: bin/pipeline-health.sh's pre-plan hit rate block fires a warn digest (preplanzero:

, retractable) when a project has at least this many builds (adopted + stale + miss) in PREPLAN_HIT_WINDOW_DAYS and adopted none. 0 = off; the hit-rate line in logs/pipeline-health.log is written either way. A value that is not a whole number falls back to 10.
BH-3437: the window the pre-plan hit rate block asks GET /api/preplans/adoption for (the route refuses outside 1-30). Out of range or not a whole number falls back to 7.

BH-4060: bin/pipeline-health.sh's wake classes armed block pages once (wakearmed:hub, retractable) when a wake-lanes-<class> flag is on but bin/wake-loop.sh has not logged 'wake classes armed:' in logs/wake-loop.log for this many seconds. 0 = off. Required: the script has no literal default; a value that is not a whole number turns the check off with one logs/pipeline-health.log line. docs/EVENTS.md section 9.

BH-3554: seconds the Cloudflare Pages production deploy of console-ui may trail the newest first-parent origin/main console-ui commit before the console pages drift block pages (consolepagesdrift:hub). 0 turns the check off (no Cloudflare call). Non-numeric falls back to 7200.

BH-3554: consecutive ticks the drift check may fail to read the Pages project (curl failure, success=false, no production commit hash) before it pages consolepagesdrift:unreadable. 3 ticks = 30 min at */10. Non-numeric or 0 falls back to 3.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend alerts block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C2). Seconds between spend alert runs (own stamp state/spend-alerts.stamp). 0 = every pipeline-health tick. Each run makes one since-midnight cost_rows read.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend alerts block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C2). A project or lane alerts when today's UTC spend reaches this multiple of its own p99 daily spend. Alert only: nothing is refused or held.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend alerts block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C2). The complete UTC days of cost_rows the p99 daily spend is measured over. The p99 table is cached once a UTC day in state/spend-alerts/baseline-<day>.tsv.
Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend alerts block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C2). A project or lane needs this many days with cost rows in the window before it has an alert line at all.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend alerts block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C2). A project alerts when its 7d cost per merged PR (state/cost/summary.json) is above this multiple of the fleet median. Alert only.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend alerts block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C2). A project needs this many merged PRs in 7d to count toward the fleet median or alert. Fewer than 3 such projects: no median, no alert.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend alerts block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C2). How long a project must stay above the per-PR line before it alerts (state/spend-alerts/perpr-over.tsv holds the start). 0 = alert at first sight.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend ceiling seed block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C3). 1 = once per UTC day, bin/spend-ceiling-seed.sh writes spend.ceiling.<lane>.day_usd for each lane that has no row yet (insert-if-absent; an existing row is never rewritten). 0 = no row is seeded; rows that exist stay and are still enforced.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend ceiling seed block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C3). A seeded runaway ceiling is this multiple of the lane's p99 daily spend, rounded up to the cent. Changes only rows not yet seeded.

Read by bin/pipeline-health.sh's spend ceiling seed block (sa_knob, BH-5526 C3). A lane gets a seeded ceiling only with at least this many UTC days of cost_rows in the p99 table. The block reads a value under 7 as 7.
